# Data provenance

**© OpenStreetMap contributors.** Historical road distances, static travel-time estimates and the D01–C30 route geometry were generated by the OSRM car routing service operated by **FOSSGIS e.V.** The traffic generator uses those static estimates to simulate observations. Commercial records and operational events are original synthetic data. [OpenStreetMap copyright](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) · [ODbL 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/) · [FOSSGIS routing service](https://routing.openstreetmap.de/about.html) · [Report or fix a map error](https://www.openstreetmap.org/fixthemap)

The qualified optional map without external tiles uses cached coordinates and schematic links where exact geometry is unavailable. See the project's [Licensing and attribution](../DATA_LICENSE.md) for the applicable terms.
